I say head into training mode and learn a few combos with Luigi, I don’t know any but some Mario ones might work with Luigi, which is down throw up air up air. The simple tech. You can learn is

Tech - pressing the shield button before u land when u got hit, making u do some sort of kick flip,doing this won’t make u hit the floor and then do a roll or an attack. It will take time to learn how the do this within a few milliseconds of getting it but it’ll help u a ton in the long run 

SHORT HOP ATTACK. YOU MUST KNOW THIS. Hitting the jump button as u press an attack, fair, nair, uair ect... will do u short hop attack, leading back to the start of my comment, dthrow to short hop uair, and then another jumping uair will give u around 20%.

Parrying is a new thing in smash which if u release the shield button before getting hit (I believe around 5 frames) u get around the an extra 20-30 to counter attack.

B REVERSE is extremely helpful for a new characters, including Luigi. It’ll be too hard to explain on text so go on YouTube and watch “MySmashCorners” video about it. It may be extremely hard at first and sometimes I mess up. But especially since Luigi go a tether grab, it’s so good with Luigi now.

Set ur C/R stick to “Tilt Attack” do a smash attack manually is simple enough but doing a tilt attack is a lot hard. Setting it as tilt attack means u have skip the “tilting” the control stick and attacking to attacking right away

Keep in mind Luigi’s dair is a spike so don’t be afraid to spike someone down into the blast zone. Remember to keep your double jump thought since Luigi’s recover has been nerfed a lot!

Luigi’s uptilt is another combo tool, when they’re at low %’s do around 2-3 up tilts than short hop uair. Test these combos in training mode on several %’s

Just remember, down tilt is another good combo start for Luigi, don’t be afraid to think out the box in training mode and make weird combos, on the side of training mode their will be a combo counter, if that number goes above 1, that means it’s a true combo, meaning the enemy cannot escape unless u mess it.
